candidates.blurb: The wave-2 primitives on the profile x path matrix, growing act by act as the build lands. PRISMS: a hex crystal erupting along the vector, a star-profile drill twisting 200 degrees, a spike field bursting from the ground in one record. PATHS: the ribbon swept along a helix and a closed orbit - the same strip, parametric spines. More acts arrive with each phase (vine growth, metaball goo, volumes, spawn chains, shatter, plasma_crown).
candidates.name: CAST WAVE 2 - growth, goo, warp

beats.t: CAST - one vector language, every primitive

beats.text: FLOWS: the beam CONNECTS ... the breath cone
MOVERS: darts ... ring bang ... sine ribbons
SPELLS: six registered sets, mixed shapes
OVERRIDE: omnislash forced into a DART storm
LERPS: custom feel as data, layered on notes or sets

candidates.blurb: The CastEngine: the slash record language generalized to a FAMILY of shader-driven primitives, every one a vector with sidecar stats, all sequenced and dressed by the same sets/looks/override grammar. Act 1 the SHELLS - a dome sealing over a unit (fresnel rim, materialize-in, ACROSS lift-off) and a void sphere. Act 2 the FLOWS - a beam CONNECTING caster to target and a churning fire breath cone. Act 3 the MOVERS - ink darts in flight, a ring bang, twin braided sine ribbons (geometry displaced IN the shader). Act 4 the SPELLS - barrier_dome, orb_burst, breath_cone, arrow_volley, beam_judgment (the old judgment choreography re-spoken as six data records), helix_ribbon. Act 5 the OVERRIDE - the omnislash storm mass-forced into a DART storm by one key, and the volley re-dressed fire. Act 6 LERPS - custom feel as pure data layered onto a single note or a whole set: a void sphere with an attached scale-up + fade-out, a shaken ring, and the ink volley with a pulse lerp LAYERED across every dart by the group (lerps concatenate through the override grammar, never replace).
candidates.name: CAST LOOKDEV - the primitive family

beats.text: 1: omnislash re-INKED - one line of override
2: the same storm, CEL: style flipbook forced
3: WHIRLWIND - each record aims its own axis
6: INK SEAL - the finisher lifts off ACROSS
7: WIND BOLT - motion=bolt, the slash as a SPELL
8: EDGE RAIN - offsets spread the sky

candidates.blurb: Eight sequenced slash effects grown from the set language, ink and cel heavy. 1) omnislash MASS-OVERRIDDEN into ink - one line: {type:omnislash, look:ink}. 2) the same storm forced into the CEL flipbook path. 3) WHIRLWIND - every record carries its OWN axis, a ring of wind streaks spinning around the unit, spun twice by repeat/every. 4) the whirlwind re-dressed cel-ink by the same override grammar. 5) DRILL VORTEX - the roll-fan, the plane spinning about one vector in 45-degree steps. 6) INK SEAL - the calligraphy set piece; the finisher leaves via the ACROSS wipe like a brush lifting. 7) WIND BOLT - motion=bolt, the slash as a SPELL: blades FLY caster to target along the axis, arriving at the impact moment. 8) EDGE RAIN - overhead void cuts raining around the target through the offset field, the last one a lamp.
candidates.name: SLASH SEQUENCES - 8 explorations

beats.text: LEADER: the weapon rides the sweep head
LIGHT: the slash is a LAMP in the house lighting
FINISH: one registered HHV set in full dress

candidates.blurb: The SlashEngine v4 catalog - every lever of the language on one night stage, section by section. LOOKS (blade/fire/ink/void; fire and void now EMIT - transient lamps in the house lighting wash the ground). STYLES (arc / streak / cel flipbook). EXITS - how a blade LEAVES: fade / wipe (with the sweep) / wipe_back / across (edge to edge) / shrink (taper to death) / collapse (energy drains INTO the wound). ANIM (materialize / burn-away / churn+scroll+flicker). LIGHT featured on the dark stage: the fire arc pooling warm ground-glow, the void cut in violet, an explicit white flash. Finisher: one registered HHV set in full dress - look, sound, light, wipe exits.
candidates.name: SLASH LOOKDEV BOOK

beats.text: the LOOKS: blade / fire / ink(bands) / void(churn)
grad AS DATA: a color list ... [pos,color] stops
ends: FLAT (the rainbow) ... vs PINCH + smear edge
the CEL path: flipbook slashes (8 hard frames)

candidates.blurb: The v3 texture system on the crossing executor. Act 1 the registered LOOKS (blade / fire / ink / void - gradient MAPPED BY ENERGY VALUE per the research canon; ink posterized into 3 chunky bands, void churning with two multiplied octave-locked noises). Act 2 gradient-AS-DATA: a bare color list and [pos,color] stops baked straight to ramps - no texture authored. Act 3 the procedural detail masks (noise erosion / dashes / double_edge). Act 4 the anim layer: a blade MATERIALIZING out of the noise front (dissolve-in), one BURNING AWAY with the glowing ember rim, and a scrolling, flickering energy cut. Act 5 the END-PINCH fix (flat rainbow-arch ends vs the default sine-envelope taper-to-points, plus the edge_noise smear lever) and the CEL PATH - slashes as procedurally BAKED FLIPBOOKS (8 hard-stepped boiling-edge frames on the same accurate geometry, still ramp-colored).
candidates.name: SlashEngine v3 - looks + anim

beats.t: SLASH v2 - crossings of the attack vector

beats.text: composed: sparks + confirms at the crossing
the triple stack - three vectors, one cut

candidates.blurb: The vector-crossing slash engine: every slash is a crossing of the attack vector (entry, the intersection impact, exit) at any roll angle. Act 1 the angle fan (0/45/90/135, auto-bias holding the edge-on case); act 2 the two styles (arc vs streak smear); act 3 the texture ramps (blade/fire/ink/void); act 4 the patterns (X-cross, flurry); act 5 composition - spark bursts + flipbook confirms AT the crossing point; act 6 the TRIPLE STACK - three simultaneous blades at stepped heights over one vector; act 7 (v3) the SET LANGUAGE - a registered {type: HHV} invocation with per-record sound, an X phrase mirrored+slowed by group modifiers through the flattener, then the locked-vs-fly motion A/B (the planted origin is the default; the traversal is the lever).
candidates.name: SlashEngine v2 - crossings

beats.t: ICON LIBRARY - page 2: pick a style

candidates.blurb: The diegetic icon set, reworked through a designer-critic loop: page 1 = the full 11x11 Icons.tex() library (redesigned shield/skull/teardrop/wax_drip + a dozen new icons) in the default register; page 2 = the STYLE MENU, the same six icons in five treatments (default / outline / engraved / stamped / wax) to pick the final look from. One house ink, many registers.
candidates.name: Icon Library - styles + set

beats.t: HOUSE DIALOG - the writ you sign

beats.body: It leaves your ledger for this run. You may find it again.
beats.title: DISCARD THIS MEMORY?

beats.body: It goes to the Hole, and does not come back.
beats.title: FORGET THIS MEMORY?

beats.body: The memory is struck from the record. This page will not be reissued.
beats.title: THE HOLE IS SEALED

candidates.blurb: The diegetic confirm system: a parchment writ over the scrim, sepia title + body, a wax-seal SEAL IT vs a struck RECANT with the amber cursor between them. A plain discard confirm, then the irreversible FORGET-THIS-MEMORY danger writ (the cursor travels to the seal, then presses it), then a one-choice notice.
candidates.name: House Dialog & Confirm

beats.t: MARIONETTE - the toy box, full potential

candidates.blurb: The FULL movement language, played like a kid with toys: four personas idle (breath, feet-planted sway, fidgets), get bounced across the yard in haphazard nose-tilting hops, then PLAY-FIGHT (wind-up lunges, knocked-over reactions with teardrop bubbles), a DISGAEA-GRADE ULTIMATE (the uppercut launcher, the camera whipping close and ORBITING the spinning victim, juggle pops, the slam into an explosion) and PERFORM the event verb set - joy-bounce, no-no, charge-POP, swoon, startle, victory waggle - before everyone is bounced home at once.
candidates.name: Marionette - The Toy Box

candidates.blurb: Research gap #6 (the Dead Cells doctrine) - the smear register in three flavours: crisp short ghosts, a long-fade trail that lingers, and a colour-shifted stretch-smear, each dash throwing flipbook sparkles as it goes.
candidates.name: Afterimage Dash

candidates.blurb: Research gap #5 — the named feel primitive: the SAME hit twice, without hitstop, then with hitstop + a light that actually flashes the ground.
candidates.name: Hitstop Impact

candidates.blurb: The pixel-explosion death: the unit bursts into its OWN pixels (chip_burst sampling the sprite), the stain keeps the receipt. death_rites' loud sibling.
candidates.name: Pixel Death

beats.t: FLAME RIG - the ground remembers it is a hearth

candidates.blurb: A whole set of tiles ablaze the shader way: one terrain-draped fire field carries the area while looping flame licks and rising smoke accent it, and the grass chars and vanishes under the spreading flame.
candidates.name: Flame Rig

candidates.blurb: Big puffy cumulus smoke, no fire required - the kind that reads as weather, not damage, and asks nothing of the framerate.

history.notes: looks great but some of the smokes turns into squared offsets that ruin the efect, smoke billow dark column had it perfectly whatever it did to minimize that, if you can figure out whats causing the squared off textures in mist its a common problem in all of the volumetrics

candidates.name: Smoke Billow - White

candidates.blurb: The oily column after the fire already had its say - fat dark puffs climbing in a real column, embers escaping, the scorch filed as the only witness.
candidates.name: Smoke Billow - Dark

beats.t: BUBBLE STREAM - something breathes down there

candidates.blurb: Something breathes at the bottom of the trench, patient and unbothered, a column of bubbles that never checks if anyone is watching.
candidates.name: Bubble Stream

beats.t: AMBIENT SPARKS - the forge, or something being the forge

candidates.blurb: A forge left running after hours - small sparks jumping off banked coals, or coals that were never banked, just left.
candidates.name: Ambient Sparks

beats.t: WATER SPLASH RIG - the ground remembers being dry

candidates.blurb: A cloudburst on one tile: localized rain falls only over this patch, the pale ring answers, and by the time the debris lands the ground has forgotten it was ever dry.
candidates.name: Water Splash Rig

beats.t: WATERFALL SHEET - falling since before anyone counted

candidates.blurb: A sheet that has been falling since long before anyone started keeping the ledger - the spray at its foot does not care whose turn it is.
candidates.name: Waterfall Sheet

beats.t: RAIN DEPTH - near, far, and underfoot
RAIN DEPTH - the storm remembers to breathe

candidates.blurb: Near rain, far rain, fog pooled at the knee - a full storm ledger, then the line goes quiet enough to hear the drips.
candidates.name: Rain Depth

beats.t: PUDDLE RINGS - real water, quietly apologizing

candidates.blurb: After the storm the field is still standing in water - a real shallow sim pool, and every circle it makes lands on a surface that actually answers back.
candidates.name: Puddle Rings

beats.t: DUST DEVIL - crossing the field like it owns it

candidates.blurb: A dust devil crossing the field like it owns the deed - three touch-downs in a line, debris and leaf litter dragged along for the ride.
candidates.name: Dust Devil Rig

beats.t: FALLING LEAVES - the year keeps its own calendar

candidates.blurb: Autumn keeps its own calendar here - TWO layers now: the full-screen fall drifts behind as the steady main, and the original flutter is back on top of it, discrete leaves that tumble and skew through the air across the whole frame.
candidates.name: Falling Leaves

beats.t: FILTER REEL - one at a time, then the pairings

candidates.blurb: The camera itself is not neutral - nine registers shown ONE AT A TIME (each held a beat, alone), then the good pairings: OLD FILM (sepia+scanlines), BROKEN TAPE (VHS+glitch), PRINTED PAGE (posterize+dither) - the filter vocabulary and how it combines.

history.notes: can we get longer holds on each filter, it flicks through them too fast

candidates.name: Filter Reel

beats.t: DITHER WIPE - the pixel-game turn of page

candidates.blurb: The Bayer matrix eats the frame in place of a cut - the classic pixel-game wipe, ordered dither standing in for a fade.
candidates.name: Dither Wipe

beats.t: GLITCH BURST - reality skips a frame

candidates.blurb: A status-curse register: the world hiccups three times, then buckles once hard - the frame itself is the symptom.
candidates.name: Glitch Burst

candidates.blurb: THE skill-cast presentation: the skill's name slams up on an askew torn-parchment writ (the house register, sepia-title-card blood) while the lens pulls focus and the caster charges (glints + gathering sparks) - hold it, hold it - then BLAM: the blur snaps off into hitstop, the burst, and the ring. (In-game this carries the charge-up SFX; renders are mute.)
candidates.name: Focus Pull

beats.t: DRUNK HAZE - the ground will not hold still

candidates.blurb: The poison/confusion register: the horizon will not sit still, and the green pooling at the feet says why.
candidates.name: Drunk Haze

beats.t: SEPIA FLASHBACK - the archive of what came before

candidates.blurb: The Cathedral's past tense as a stack of aged archival cards: under a held sepia wash and drifting dust, four parchment title treatments open in turn - a torn deckled page, a ruled ledger entry, a wax-sealed decree, and an ink-bled inscription - each with its own entrance.
candidates.name: Sepia Flashback

beats.t: BLAST FOG BANK - the explosion leaves its breath

candidates.blurb: Her re-brief: the fog as a huge explosion side-effect - the blast throws out a rolling ground bank that owns the field for a breath, then thins to nothing.

history.notes: can you make it erupting and then fades out, like a huge explosion side effect

candidates.name: Blast Fog Bank

beats.t: SHOCK RING - the primitive, then the flair

candidates.blurb: The mesh-ring primitive, then the mesh-ring with FLAIR - glint, freeze, the ring, and a full flipbook chain (flame, spark, electric, smoke) layered on top - one primitive, two ways to spend it.
candidates.name: Shock Ring Mesh

beats.t: ERUPTION SHELL - the ground keeps a grudge

candidates.blurb: A ground eruption with a fair warning circle first - the world always tells you before it opens. The blast burns the grass to ash and leaves a scorched crater, oily dark smoke racing up through slow white billows behind it.

history.notes: it doesnt interact well because of the pillar, can you put it in a different spot
the procedural grass must render below the madoka circles, all of the ground plane aligned stuff must follow this rule

candidates.name: Eruption Shell

beats.t: DEBRIS PERMANENCE - the litter is the point

candidates.blurb: Three impacts, three colors, one held wide shot - the point is not the hit, it is what is still lying there after.
candidates.name: Debris Permanence

candidates.blurb: Two outline techniques: the alpha-dilation stroke (gold SELECT / red THREAT / green PROC) and the scaled-silhouette copy behind the sprite (STROKE / SKEWED), skewable and rollable for character.

history.notes: its not aligned with the billboard correctly, its intersecting. figure out a better shader based way we can do this that still lets us do lerp animatins for cool lead ins

candidates.name: Outline Language

beats.t: TITLE CARD DESIGNS - four flashback voices

candidates.blurb: A rack of flashback title-card styles under the sepia grade - tilted parchment, a carved dark plaque, a torn hasty note, and a red-ink decree - each with its own entrance - a drop, a thump, a waggle, a slam - so the past tense can pick its voice.
candidates.name: Title Card Designs

requests.response: three hybrids live in ACTIVE: heavy_hit (the solid-blow tier - bigger star + chroma whisper + weight, no frame-invert), combo_finisher (hit-hit-CRIT escalating in one beat with climbing damage numbers), counter_hit (the cold-blue interrupt with reversed speedline bias + COUNTER chip). Verdict away.
requests.text: add some new hit effeccts that combine the crit and hit types

requests.response: four epics live in ACTIVE: the_audit (the dragon counts the field - scan circles, tally threads, AUDITED), convergence_echo (six faction circles lattice into a hexagram, bloom white, one remains), gnomon_measure (the measuring ray sweeps and every unit gets its letter), the_drowning (the dam-break at ult scale with the codex showing through the flood). Verdict away.
